description_text: Proposed procurement for NSN 5950010191924 TRANSFORMER,POWER: Line 0001 Qty 26 UI EA Deliver To: By: 0176 DAYS ADO This Solicitation may result in an Automated IDC (Indefinite Delivery Contract).
